mechanism: Torsemide causes electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hyponatremia) and volume depletion which can potentiate anticholinergic effects of tolterodine and increase cardiac arrhythmia risk, particularly in susceptible patients.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes regularly, ensure adequate potassium levels, assess for urinary retention and orthostatic hypotension, and consider alternative antimuscarinic if volume depletion occurs.
